thread:
sre_oncall: Observed a sudden surge of 503/504 and connection timeouts hitting /v1/infer endpoints from the hosted edge gateway. Error rate jumped at 18:46 UTC, affecting ~40% of requests. Customers reporting timeouts. Investigating now.

support_jen: multiple support tickets just came in (high-priority). Top customers seeing 30-60s client-side hangs, some 5xx. Escalated to enterprise queue.

mike_p: grabbing logs. Quick mitigation suggestion: enable fallback to smaller model variant and bump concurrency limit on gateway to reduce request queuing. Rolling a canary now.

infra_dan: logs show gateway pods returning 503 with "upstream reset" and a lot of HTTP keepalive errors. Kube events show several OOMKilled for model-shard pods around the same time. Possible cache growth.

deploy-bot: deploy event: infra/k8s-configs v2027.03.15-4 pushed at 18:40 UTC by infra_dan.

eva_rd: we shipped a cache change in model-shard pooling last week that increased max-blob retention. Could be correlated. Adding config rollback to hypothesis.

mike_p: mitigation steps executed: 1) routed traffic away from eu-west cluster -> fallback regional routing 2) rolled gateway concurrency back to 250 -> 100 3) triggered rollback of k8s-configs to v2027.03.08. Quick curl check after routing change: 
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/infer -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"hello"}' -v
```
response: 200 OK on canary, 503 on eu-west primary.

sre_oncall: Confirmed rollback and routing change reduced 5xx to baseline within ~4 minutes. Customer impact window ~18:46–18:52 UTC. Logged incident with severity P1.

support_jen: I've notified affected accounts and opened compensatory credit discussions. Keeping them posted.

infra_dan: root-cause indicators: memory growth in model-shard process (observed RSS growth ~2x within 10m during heavy prefix caching). When pods hit OOM, upstream connection reset cascades to gateway -> 503s. We'll need a config limit and better eviction.

eva_rd: action item: add cache eviction threshold + bounded cache by size rather than age, and add continuous memory sampling per shard. I can take this, ETA EOD tomorrow.

mike_p: infra action: add pod-level circuit breaker so gateway will fail fast instead of queuing. Also add per-route retry/backoff adjustments. I'll own, ETA 2 days.

sre_oncall: ops action: increase default rollout watch to 10m for k8s-configs and add integration test that simulates cache-filling workload before rolling. I'll file the PR.

deploy-bot: incident created: INC-2027-1802006789, severity=P1.

support_jen: summarizing for postmortem thread and customers. Will attach timelines and tickets.

mike_p: small follow-up: add a health-check path that returns shard cache metrics so LB can avoid unhealthy pods.

eva_rd: added to my card.

sre_oncall: Postmortem action items (quick list):
- eva_rd: implement bounded cache (owner: eva_rd, due: 2027-03-16)
- mike_p: add circuit breaker + health-check metrics (owner: mike_p, due: 2027-03-17)
- infra_dan: add OOM alert + sample memory metric to dashboard (owner: infra_dan, due: 2027-03-16)
- support_jen: customer comms + credit proposals (owner: support_jen, due: 2027-03-15)
- sre_oncall: rollout policy update + integration test for config changes (owner: sre_oncall, due: 2027-03-18)

support_jen: noted and cc-ing account execs. Will draft the customer message and ask legal for wording.

sre_oncall: thanks all. Closing the war room, moving to postmortem. Please add any follow-ups to INC-2027-1802006789 in the incident tracker. :thumbsup:
notes: mitigation: rollback, regional routing, concurrency reduce; root cause: unbounded cache growth causing OOMs -> upstream resets -> gateway 503s; action items assigned
